cash_rich_accumulator.short_description: Strong liquidity and disciplined saving, with limited exposure to growth investments.
cash_rich_accumulator.long_description: Your current financial pattern most closely resembles a Cash-Rich Accumulator. You hold a significant share of your financial assets in cash and deposits, carry little debt, and maintain strong emergency reserves. This gives you real resilience against short-term shocks, though it may mean your long-term wealth grows more slowly than it could.

wealth_builder.short_description: Disciplined saving and regular investing, building net worth steadily over time.
wealth_builder.long_description: Your current financial pattern most closely resembles a Wealth Builder. You save and invest consistently, keep debt under control, and your net worth is trending upward. This is a strong long-term compounding position, provided diversification and protection keep pace with your growing wealth.

lifestyle_optimiser.short_description: Strong income supporting a rich lifestyle today, with room to build long-term savings momentum.
lifestyle_optimiser.long_description: Your current financial pattern most closely resembles a Lifestyle Optimiser. Your income supports a comfortable, flexible lifestyle, with discretionary spending making up a large share of your budget. Building a stronger automatic savings habit would help convert more of today's income into long-term wealth.

property_focused_investor.short_description: Wealth concentrated in property, supported by mortgage leverage.
property_focused_investor.long_description: Your current financial pattern most closely resembles a Property-Focused Investor. You have built a significant share of your wealth through property, supported by mortgage leverage. Your balance sheet has strong asset backing, but your liquid assets and investment diversification are relatively limited.

debt_constrained_builder.short_description: Reasonable income currently absorbed by debt repayments, limiting monthly flexibility.
debt_constrained_builder.long_description: Your current financial pattern most closely resembles a Debt-Constrained Builder. A significant share of your income is currently directed toward debt repayments, limiting the cash available for saving and investing. Reducing high-cost debt is likely to unlock the fastest improvement in your financial position.

future_ready_professional.short_description: Strong earning capacity and healthy habits, with time on your side for compounding.
future_ready_professional.long_description: Your current financial pattern most closely resembles a Future-Ready Professional. Your income capacity, savings habits and manageable debt put you in a strong position to build significant wealth over time, even if your accumulated net worth is still developing.

financial_stabiliser.short_description: Focused on building basic financial stability and a foundation to grow from.
financial_stabiliser.long_description: Your current financial pattern most closely resembles a Financial Stabiliser. Your household is working to establish stable cash flow and a basic financial buffer. Small, consistent changes to essential spending and emergency savings tend to produce the fastest improvement from here.

retirement_focused_preserver.short_description: Focused on preserving capital and sustaining income through retirement.
retirement_focused_preserver.long_description: Your current financial pattern most closely resembles a Retirement-Focused Preserver. Your focus has shifted from accumulation to preserving capital and generating sustainable income, typically supported by retirement savings and reduced debt.
